skill.name: Commit/Merge
skill.strategic_description: Slides the board in a direction so matching adjacent tiles combine into a larger tile, changing the board layout and sometimes increasing the highest tile.

steps: Observe current state and enumerate possible directional transformations
Discard directions that would leave the state unchanged
Choose the intended valid direction under current policy
Apply the chosen transformation across the entire state
Confirm the state changed according to the chosen direction
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Merge Matching Tiles
contract.description: Slide toward a direction that brings identical numbered tiles together so they combine into one higher-value tile.

common_preconditions: It is the agent’s turn to act in a 2048 game state and a board slide/merge move is allowed.
A target direction for the slide has been selected or can be selected from the available directions.
execution_hint.state_transition_pattern: Slides the board in a direction so matching adjacent tiles combine into a larger
termination_cues: The selected slide direction was executed without error.
The resulting board differs from the previous board by at least one tile movement or one merge.
common_failure_modes: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
execution_hint.execution_description: Slides the board in a direction so matching adjacent tiles combine into a larger tile, changing the board layout and sometimes increasing the highest

preconditions: It is the agent’s turn to act in a 2048 game state and a board slide/merge move is allowed.
A target direction for the slide has been selected or can be selected from the available directions.
The intended move would change the board state by shifting at least one tile or merging at least one adjacent equal-value tile.
steps: Read the current board and enumerate the four possible slide directions: up, down, left, right.
Determine which directions are legal by checking whether sliding in that direction would move any tile or merge any adjacent equal tiles.
If no legal direction exists, stop and treat the state as game over.
Select the intended direction according to the controlling policy or plan.
Verify again that the selected direction is legal and would change the board.
Execute a single slide of the full board in the selected direction.
During the slide, compress tiles toward the chosen side, merge each pair of adjacent equal tiles at most once for this move, and continue resolving the board according to 2048 rules.
success_criteria: The selected slide direction was executed without error.
The resulting board differs from the previous board by at least one tile movement or one merge.
Any valid merges were applied correctly according to 2048 rules, with no tile merged more than once in the same move.
abort_criteria: No legal slide direction exists because no move would change the board.
A direction cannot be selected from the policy or plan.
The chosen direction is found to be illegal because it would leave the board unchanged.

skill.name: Compare/Merge
skill.strategic_description: Merges matching tiles after a shift, producing a new board configuration while keeping the highest tile at 128 and board_changed true.

steps: Identify the active movement axis and affected ordered groups
Compact non-empty elements toward the chosen leading edge
Check adjacent leading elements for equal merge eligibility
Combine one eligible pair once and clear the consumed element
Confirm updated groups preserve single-merge and state change rules
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Prefer Merge-Preserving Move
contract.description: In 2048, choose the swipe that keeps equal tiles lined up and avoids separating promising pairs, so future merges stay available.

common_preconditions: A 2048 board shift has just been applied or is being simulated in a chosen direction.
At least one row or column in the direction of motion contains adjacent equal non-zero tiles after compression.
execution_hint.state_transition_pattern: Merges matching tiles after a shift, producing a new board configuration while k
termination_cues: Every row or column affected by the shift has been compressed, merged once per eligible adjacent pair, and recompressed according to 2048 rules.
No tile has merged more than once during this move.
common_failure_modes: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
execution_hint.execution_description: Merges matching tiles after a shift, producing a new board configuration while keeping the highest tile at 128 and board_changed true.

preconditions: A 2048 board shift has just been applied or is being simulated in a chosen direction.
At least one row or column in the direction of motion contains adjacent equal non-zero tiles after compression.
The goal is to resolve compare/merge behavior according to 2048 rules.
steps: Identify the active shift direction and process each affected line in movement order.
For each row or column, compress non-zero tiles toward the shift side, preserving order.
Scan the compressed line from the leading edge toward the trailing edge.
When two adjacent tiles are equal and non-zero, merge them into one tile at the leading position with doubled value.
Set the consumed tile position to 0 and mark that pair as already merged so it cannot merge again this move.
Continue scanning the remainder of the line without allowing chain merges from the newly created tile in the same move.
After all possible merges in the line are resolved, compress the line again toward the shift side to remove gaps.
success_criteria: Every row or column affected by the shift has been compressed, merged once per eligible adjacent pair, and recompressed according to 2048 rules.
No tile has merged more than once during this move.
The resulting board matches the legal post-merge configuration for the chosen shift.
abort_criteria: The board is not a valid 4x4 2048 grid.
Compression reveals no legal adjacent equal non-zero tiles and this skill is intended only for merge resolution.

skill.name: Mid Optimize
skill.strategic_description: Applies an optimizing move in 2048: rearranges the board by sliding and often merging tiles, typically improving consolidation, sometimes increasing the highest tile, and yielding a new board configuration.

steps: Observe current state and enumerate feasible next actions
Project each action outcome against structural optimization priorities
Discard actions that disrupt stability, progress, or future flexibility
Choose the action best preserving and improving strategy
Apply the selected action to advance the state
abort_criteria: No progress toward skill objective after several moves

contract.name: Merge Toward Corner
contract.description: In 2048, keep sliding so your largest tile stays anchored in one corner and nearby tiles feed into it for easy merges.

common_preconditions: A valid 2048 board state is available and it is the agent’s turn to make exactly one move.
At least one legal slide direction exists that changes the board.
execution_hint.state_transition_pattern: Applies an optimizing move in 2048: rearranges the board by sliding and often me
termination_cues: Exactly one legal move was executed.
The board changed in a way consistent with 2048 sliding and merging rules.
common_failure_modes: No progress toward skill objective after several moves
execution_hint.execution_description: Applies an optimizing move in 2048: rearranges the board by sliding and often merging tiles, typically improving consolidation, sometimes increasing t

preconditions: A valid 2048 board state is available and it is the agent’s turn to make exactly one move.
At least one legal slide direction exists that changes the board.
The objective for this turn is optimization rather than random play, such as improving consolidation, preserving mobility, supporting a corner-anchor strategy, or enabling high-value merges.
steps: Read the current board and list all legal moves among up, down, left, and right.
For each legal move, simulate the full 2048 result of that move, including all valid merges and the resulting board before any new random tile spawn.

Score each simulated board using optimization priorities in this order: keep the highest tile anchored in a corner, maximize immediate merge value, increase empty-cell count, improve monotonic ordering toward the anchor corner, keep high tiles adjacent and consolidated, and avoid moves that scatter large tiles or break the established structure.
Penalize any simulated move that pulls the highest tile away from its anchor corner, creates isolated large tiles, reduces future mobility, or forces likely oscillation without progress.
If multiple moves remain close, prefer the move that preserves the current dominant strategy, typically continuing to build toward the same corner and edge.
Select the highest-scoring legal move.
Execute the chosen move on the actual game state.
success_criteria: Exactly one legal move was executed.
The board changed in a way consistent with 2048 sliding and merging rules.
The chosen move is the best available move under the stated optimization priorities or a valid tie-broken equivalent.
abort_criteria: No current board state is available or the state is invalid.
It is not the agent’s turn or the environment does not permit a move.
No legal moves exist because the game is over.
